Messages.Author: Elgnat
Messages.Body:
Because of reasons, I am working on a Gr 4/5 Baali deck that runs shatter the gate.
It will probably feature Nergal, Cybele and Petaniqua as main Vamps and some smaller for backup. Anyhow, looking through cards, I have three questions that perhaps some more
experienced players can help me with.

1: Intercept, how to get it.
Yup. How does this get efficiently get intercept? I can use magic of the smith/equipment to get some. Only a few of the Vamps have Auspex, is it worth to use? Sense the Sin seems like
a really good card, but how do I get corruption counters onto the board?

2: Unleash Hell's Fury
Is this card generally considered worth it? I cant' judge it. The 2 pool cost seems steep
to me.

3: Blood gain
Is there perhaps some nice trick/engine to bloat with this? The cybelotron does it really
nicely, but I'm not sure it would work with this deck.

Any help and feedback appreciated

Best Regards
